description: This file implements version 2 of a streaming protocol for remote command execution and attachment in Kubernetes, including stream creation, copying stdin/stdout/stderr, and error handling.

classes.name: streamProtocolV2
classes.description: Implements version 2 of the streaming protocol for attach and exec in Kubernetes.

classes.name: errorDecoderV2
classes.description: Decodes error messages from the error stream as plain text.

methods.name: createStreams
methods.description: Creates error, stdin, stdout, and stderr streams over a connection.

methods.name: copyStdin
methods.description: Copies data from client's stdin to remote stdin, handling goroutine synchronization and stream closure.

methods.name: copyStdout
methods.description: Copies data from remote stdout to client's stdout, running in a goroutine.

methods.name: copyStderr
methods.description: Copies data from remote stderr to client's stderr, running in a goroutine.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Coordinates stream creation, copying, and error handling for remote command execution.
